title: About EnteMLA

about.hero_desc: Empowering citizens through transparent governance, digital complaint tracking, and direct communication with elected representatives.
about.what_is_p1: EnteMLA is a modern digital civic grievance management platform that connects citizens and their elected representatives through a unified system.
about.what_is_p2: Citizens can easily register complaints, track their progress in real-time, and receive official responses and updates.
about.what_is_p3: The primary goal is to improve transparency and accountability in governance.
about.why_intro: Traditional complaint systems are often slow, unclear, and difficult for citizens to access efficiently.
why_points: Lack of status updates and transparency
about.why_outro: EnteMLA was designed as a digital solution to address these governance challenges.
about.feature_1_desc: Citizens can submit complaints with categories, urgency levels, and detailed descriptions.
about.feature_2_desc: Track complaint progress and updates instantly.
about.feature_3_desc: Receive official replies and updates directly from authorities.
about.feature_4_desc: Separate and secure access for citizens, employees, and MLAs.
about.feature_5_desc: Urgent complaints are prioritized for faster resolution.
about.feature_6_desc: Citizens can participate in transparent discussions about local issues.
about.step1_desc: Citizens securely create accounts and access the platform.
about.step2_desc: Users submit complaints with categories and detailed information.
about.step3_desc: Complaints are reviewed and forwarded to the responsible department.
about.step4_desc: Citizens receive updates until the complaint is fully resolved.
about.role_mla: MLA: Monitor and oversee the overall system.
about.vision_p1: Our vision is to create a transparent governance system where every citizen’s voice is heard and addressed efficiently.
about.vision_p2: We aim to strengthen trust between citizens and governance through technology and innovation.

faq_q1: How can I submit a complaint?
faq_a1: You can submit a complaint through the Complaint Portal by providing details and selecting the category.
faq_q2: How long does it take to resolve a complaint?
faq_a2: Most complaints are addressed within 48 hours depending on severity and department workload.
faq_q3: Can I track my complaint status?
faq_a3: Yes, you can track your complaint using the unique tracking ID provided after submission.
contact_hero_desc: Access MLA offices and important government department contacts across Kerala constituencies.
